description: This file defines configuration flag classes and components for the 'cuttlefish' project, including an interface for system image directory flags and a placeholder for configuration flags, utilizing the Fruit dependency injection framework.

classes.name: SystemImageDirFlag
classes.description: An interface class for flags related to system image directories, inheriting from FlagFeature, with a pure virtual method Path() returning the directory path.

classes.name: ConfigFlag
classes.description: A class representing a configuration flag, inheriting from FlagFeature, with no additional members.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Pure virtual method to retrieve the system image directory path.
